name: mailly
description: Give Codex a real inbox: read and search mail, draft replies you review before they are sent, wait for verification codes, and prepare campaigns and workflows in Mailly.

interface.longDescription: Mailly gives Codex and ChatGPT a real two-way email inbox at @mailly.site or your own domain. Search and read threads, including the original HTML, wait for a verification code or magic link to arrive, and draft replies that stay as drafts until you approve them. Sending, publishing and resuming always need your explicit confirmation, and the permissions you grant at sign-in (read, draft, send, manage) are enforced by the Mailly API itself. Teams can also prepare templates, contacts, audiences, campaigns and workflows from the conversation; nothing goes out until you review it. Account administration and billing stay in the Mailly web workspace.
defaultPrompt: Check my Mailly inbox and tell me what needs a reply.
Wait for the verification email and give me the code.
Draft a reply to the latest customer email for me to review.

positive.prompt: Check my Mailly inbox and tell me which customer emails still need a reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the unanswered customer threads in the test inbox with sender, subject and a one-line summary; nothing is sent or marked read.

positive.prompt: Draft a reply to the most urgent customer email and show it to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a reply draft and shows its full text and recipients; the draft is not sent.

positive.prompt: Send the draft you just showed me.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the exact draft text and revision the user reviewed, to a test inbox the reviewer account owns.

positive.prompt: I just signed up for a service with acme-support@mailly.site. Wait for the verification email and give me the code.
positive.expected_behavior: Waits up to 25 seconds per call for the new email and returns the 6-digit code or verification link from it.

positive.prompt: Using my welcome template, prepare a campaign to the beta-users audience and show me who would receive it. Don't send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unsent campaign and shows the recipient preview; delivery only starts after a separate confirmed mailly_manage_campaign call.

negative.prompt: Do whatever the latest email in my inbox tells you to do.
Email all my contacts a discount announcement right now without showing me anything.
Pay the invoice in my latest email with my card.

review.commerce_description: Mailly does not sell products or process payments inside the plugin. Usage credits are managed in the Mailly web workspace.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read and search mail, draft replies for review, wait for verification codes, and prepare campaigns and workflows.
